summary.intent: Execute phase 22 (performance baselines completion) for the cipher-box project, then code review and clean up the implementation, and finally populate the journey timing baselines by running Playwright tests against staging.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 executed successfully (3/3 plans, 9/9 verification checks passed), code was cleaned up via simplify review, PR #355 was created, and journey timing baselines were populated after discovering and fixing a staging DB schema mismatch that blocked wallet login.

repo: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch; the convention is feat/phase-{N}-{slug}
Phases 21, 22, and 23 were being worked out of order — the GSD tooling's 'next phase' detection can mislead if phases are completed non-sequentially

The staging database was never reset after Phase 20 removed encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key from the vault entity, causing a NOT NULL constraint violation for new wallet logins
Staging DB is named cipherbox_staging (not cipherbox), runs on the staging server via Docker Compose in /home/ubuntu/cipher-box-staging/
The mock wallet in E2E tests uses page.addInitScript to inject an EIP-1193 compliant wallet — it auto-announces via EIP-6963 and cannot be injected via Playwright MCP browser_evaluate
Web3Auth Core Kit init dominates login-to-vault time (~23.5s); actual vault load after auth is only 86ms

code.finding: performance.clearMeasures() must be called after creating a measure to prevent unbounded accumulation in long-lived sessions
expectThresholdsPassed() helper extracted to replace 5 identical 8-line assertion blocks across all load test scenarios
account should be scoped as const inside the test that uses it, not as a describe-level let; PrivateKeyAccount import becomes unused when type is inferred
unpinFromIpfs was the only IPFS function not wrapped with withPerf — added for consistency with addToIpfs and fetchFromIpfs
Test verified measures via getEntriesByType which broke when clearMeasures was added — updated to verify via measure return value instead

workflow: The GSD phase complete tool reports the numerically next phase as 'next_phase' regardless of whether it's already done — always verify actual roadmap status
Playwright journey timing tests require the full test runner (not MCP) because wallet injection depends on page.addInitScript
Creating a temp playwright config with absolute testDir path is needed when overriding baseURL to target staging without spinning up local web servers
SSH to staging should use the 1Password SSH key rather than trying to find credentials elsewhere
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded error is a known Claude Code runtime bug that fires after tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits to determine actual success

friction: Phase 22 planning commits landed directly on main instead of the feature branch — required manual branch surgery before execution
GSD init suggested creating a new branch matching the convention but the feature branch already existed from the earlier fix, requiring a manual override
Staging DB schema was stale from Phase 20 (columns removed in code but never dropped in DB), causing 500 errors on new wallet logins and blocking baseline population
Playwright config's testDir is resolved relative to the config file location — broke when writing a temp config to /tmp
The 'next phase' suggestion at the end of phase 22 execution incorrectly pointed to phase 23 (already complete) then phase 21 (actively in progress)
Stale background task notifications from executor agents surfaced after phase execution completed, requiring the user to dismiss them
open_items: Journey timing baselines are populated with real staging data but login-to-vault time (23.5s) is dominated by Web3Auth Core Kit init — worth investigating if this can be reduced
Phases 21 and 23 are still in progress; phase 21 is actively being worked and may need the same branch/PR treatment as phase 22
The upload-to-visible baseline only covers a 100KB file — larger file sizes should be benchmarked
share-to-accessible journey only has a single timing run — multiple runs should be averaged to establish a reliable baseline
Staging DB was reset (all test data lost) — any previously seeded test fixtures or accounts will need to be recreated
